description: This file provides utility functions for testing Orleans streaming functionalities, including logging, pub-sub counting, and assertions within test scenarios.

classes.name: StreamTestUtils
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for testing Orleans stream provider functionalities, including logging, pub-sub validation, and assertions.

methods.name: LogStartTest
methods.description: Logs the start of a test with details like test name, stream ID, provider name, and silo addresses.

methods.name: LogEndTest
methods.description: Logs the end of a test with the test name.

methods.name: GetStreamPubSub
methods.description: Retrieves the pub-sub interface for a given Orleans internal cluster client.

methods.name: CheckPubSubCounts
methods.description: Checks and asserts the expected number of publishers and consumers for a specific stream, with retries and timeout.

methods.name: Assert_AreEqual
methods.description: Custom assertion method to compare expected and actual values, with logging.
